Class InMemoryRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>>

java.lang.Object
repository.InMemoryRepository<ID,E>
Type Parameters:
ID - tipul identificatorului unic al entitatii
E - tipul entitatii stocate, care extinde Entity de ID
All Implemented Interfaces:
Repository<ID,E>
public class InMemoryRepository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>> extends Object implements Repository<ID,E>
Implementare in memorie a interfetei Repository, utilizand o colectie de tip Map[cite: 3].
